**States**

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
**Cultural festivals**

Bihar

 
 
 
I.

(B)

options.text: A - IV, B - II, C - I, D - III
A - III, B - I, C - IV, D - II
A - I, B - IV, C - III, D - II
A - I, B - II, C - III, D - IV

solution:
The correct answer is __**A - IV, B - II, C - I, D - III.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer matches **Bihar with Chhath**, **Arunachal Pradesh with Tam Ladu, Assam with Bihu**, and **Goa with Fatorpa Zatra.**
 
• **Chhath** is a popular festival in **Bihar,** where people worship the **sun god** and take dips in rivers and ponds.
 
• **Tam Ladu** is a festival in **Arunachal Pradesh** that celebrates the **harvest season**, and people offer prayers and sacrifices to the deities.
 
• **Bihu** is a set of three cultural festivals in **Assam** that mark the beginning of the **agricultural season** and involve dance, music, and feasting.
 
• **Fatorpa Zatra** is a carnival-like festival in **Goa** that honors the village deity and includes** parades, music, and fireworks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bihar** is also known for other festivals like **Makar Sankranti, Holi, and Diwali.**
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** has several other festivals like **Losar, Dree, and Si-Donyi.**
 
• **Assam** also celebrates festivals like **Durga Puja, Eid, and Christmas.**
 
• **Goa** is famous for its** Carnival, Christmas, **and **New Year celebrations.**
